resources.name: Cat Store — Agent API
resources.description: Local conversation API. Start the services, set customer_token, then create a conversation and send a message. Live chat calls use the configured paid provider. Approval requests change the stored order address; run deliberately, not as a bulk collection.

data.message_text: Use find-order once for my order ord_123, then tell me its ID and status.
data.proposal_text: Propose changing the delivery address of my order ord_125 to 456 Insomnia Test Street. Do not apply the change.

resources.name: 01 — Create conversation
resources.description: Saves the returned ID as conversation_id and resets retry state. Starts a new history; does not call a model.

resources.name: 03 — Load history / recover after disconnect
resources.description: Returns messages, ordered turn statuses, approval states and active. Repeat until active=false after cancelling a stream. Also saves the newest unexpired pending confirmation ID.
resources.preRequestScript: if (!insomnia.environment.get('conversation_id')) throw new Error('Run Create conversation first.');

resources.name: 01 — Send new message
resources.description: Calls the live model. Edit message_text in the environment. Every Send creates a fresh request ID; use Replay last message for a retry. The script safely JSON-encodes text, including quotes/newlines. Request timeout should be 180000 ms.

resources.name: 02 — Follow-up using stored history
resources.description: Calls the live model with a new request ID. No history is sent by the client. Run Send new message first.

resources.name: 03 — Replay last message (no new ID)
resources.description: Run after the last turn has completed. Reuses the exact request ID and text; returns saved turn status as JSON without model execution. While active, the server returns 409; load history instead.

resources.name: 04 — Reject reused ID with changed text (409)
01 — Request address proposal (live model)
resources.description: Creates a proposal for seeded order ord_125. Does not apply the address change. Proposals expire after five minutes.

resources.name: 02 — Load history and capture pending proposal
resources.description: Sets confirmation_id from a server-stored pending, unexpired proposal. Run after requesting the proposal.
resources.preRequestScript: if (!insomnia.environment.get('conversation_id')) throw new Error('Run Create conversation first.');

resources.name: 03 — APPROVE AND APPLY stored address change
resources.description: MUTATION: approves and immediately applies the exact server-stored proposal. This changes the order delivery address. Send deliberately; do not run the whole collection blindly. Repeated sends reuse the approval request ID to avoid duplicate execution. Refresh history afterwards.

resources.name: Reject client-managed history (400)
resources.preRequestScript:
if (!insomnia.environment.get('conversation_id')) throw new Error('Run Create conversation first.');
insomnia.request.body.update({ mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ requestId: require('uuid').v4(), text: 'Hello', messages: [{ role: 'assistant', parts: [] }] }) });

resources.name: Reject client tool results (400)
resources.preRequestScript:
if (!insomnia.environment.get('conversation_id')) throw new Error('Run Create conversation first.');
insomnia.request.body.update({ mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ requestId: require('uuid').v4(), text: 'Hello', toolCalls: [{ name: 'change-address', output: { approved: true } }] }) });

resources.name: Reject malformed request ID (400)
resources.preRequestScript:
if (!insomnia.environment.get('conversation_id')) throw new Error('Run Create conversation first.');
insomnia.request.body.update({ mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ requestId: require('uuid').v4(), text: 'Hello', requestId: 'invalid' }) });

resources.name: Reject text over 4000 characters (400)
resources.preRequestScript:
if (!insomnia.environment.get('conversation_id')) throw new Error('Run Create conversation first.');
insomnia.request.body.update({ mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ requestId: require('uuid').v4(), text: 'x'.repeat(4001) }) });

resources.name: Reject body over 100 KiB (413)
resources.preRequestScript:
if (!insomnia.environment.get('conversation_id')) throw new Error('Run Create conversation first.');
insomnia.request.body.update({ mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ requestId: require('uuid').v4(), text: 'Hello', ignored: 'x'.repeat(102400) }) });

resources.name: Reject invalid customer token (401)
resources.preRequestScript: if (!insomnia.environment.get('conversation_id')) throw new Error('Run Create conversation first.');

resources.name: Reject unknown conversation (404)
resources.description: Valid UUID with no matching owned conversation. This is not a second-customer authorization test: demo authentication exposes only one customer token.
